name: Hakeem Jeffries

lean.basis: Democratic congressman since 2013 and House Democratic leader since 2023.

sources.title: Hakeem Jeffries — Wikipedia

current_role: House Democratic Leader (since January 2023); running for Speaker in January 2027
summary: Hakeem Jeffries, a Brooklyn congressman since 2013, succeeded Nancy Pelosi as House Democratic leader in January 2023. After Democrats won the House in November 2026 he launched his bid to become Speaker in January, when he would be the first Black Speaker.
